1: Aise huroof ke baare mein baat Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein ho chuki hai. Is surah ki yeh buland aayatein, aur woh Quran jo Allah ne aap par utara, aey Rasool, haqq hain jis mein koi be-yaqeeni nahin. Is mein koi shak nahin ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai, magar aksar log hath-dharmi aur gurur ki wajah se is par iman nahin laate.
2: Allah hi hai jis ne aasmaano ko bina kisi aise sahaare ke buland kiya jise tum dekh sako. Phir Woh Arsh par qayam hua aur Us ne sooraj aur chaand ko apni makhlooq ke faide ke liye kaam par laga diya. Sooraj aur chaand dono ek muqarrar muddat tak chalte rahenge jise sirf Allah hi jaanta hai. Woh, paak hai Woh, aasmaano aur zameen ke tamam maamlaat apni marzi se chalata hai. Aur Woh apni qudrat batane wali nishaniyan khol kar bayan karta hai, is umeed par ke tumhein Qayamat ke din apne Rubb se milne ka yaqeen ho jaye aur tum neik aamaal se us ki tayyari karo.
3: Wohi, paak hai Woh, hai jis ne zameen ko bichhaya aur us par mazboot pahaad banaye taake woh logon ko dagmagane na de. Aur har tarah ke phal se Us ne do qismein banayin, jaise jaanwaron mein nar aur maada. Aur Woh raat ka parda din par daal deta hai, is liye roshni ke baad andhera ho jata hai. Jo kuch bayan hua, us mein un logon ke liye nishaniyan aur dalilein hain jo Allah ki takhleeq par gaur aur soch-bichaar karte hain, kyunke wahi log hain jo in nishaniyon aur dalilon se faida uthate hain.
4: Aur zameen mein ek doosre se mile hue tukde hain, angoor ke baagh, kheti, aur khajoor ke darakht: kuch ek hi jad se nikle hue aur kuch alag alag jadon wale. In tamam baagon aur fasalon ko ek hi paani se seencha jata hai, phir bhi Main un mein se kuch ko doosron par zaiqe aur doosre faidon mein behtar bana deta hoon, chahe woh ek doosre ke paas hain aur ek hi paani se seenche jate hain. Is mein aql walon ke liye nishaniyan aur dalilein hain, kyunke wahi log hain jo is par dhyaan dete hain.
5: Aey Rasool, agar aap ko kisi cheez par taajjub hona hai, to aap ko un ke dobara zinda hone ke inkaar par aur apne inkaar ki daleel mein un ki is baat par taajjub hona chahiye: kya jab hum mar jayenge aur mitti aur bosida, ghuli hui haddiyan ban jayenge, to kya hum dobara zinda kiye jayenge aur phir se khade kiye jayenge? Jo log maut ke baad dobara zinda hone ko jhutlate hain, wahi log hain jinhon ne apne Rubb ka inkaar kiya, aur isi wajah se unhon ne Us ki murdon ko zinda karne ki qudrat ka bhi inkaar kiya. Yahi log hain jin ki gardanon mein Qayamat ke din aag ki zanjeerein daali jayengi. Yahi Aag ke rehne wale honge aur us mein hamesha rahenge, na mitenge aur na un ka azaab khatam hoga.
6: Aur aey Rasool, mushrik aap se azaab jald maangte hain aur poochte hain ke un par aane mein itni der kyun lag rahi hai, is se pehle ke woh un naimaton se poora maza le lein jo Allah ne un ke liye muqarrar ki hain. Halanke in jaisi bahut si sazaayein un jaisi qaumon par pehle aa chuki hain jinhon ne kufr kiya. Phir woh un se sabaq kyun nahin lete? Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb logon ke zulm ke baawajood unhein maaf karne wala hai. Is liye Woh un se badla lene mein jaldi nahin karta aur unhein Allah ki taraf tauba ka mauqa deta hai. Aur Woh un logon ko saza dene mein be-shak sakht hai jo apne jhutlane par ade rehte hain, agar woh tauba na karein.
7: Aur jin logon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya, aur apne jhutlane aur apni hath-dharmi par ade rahe, woh kehte hain: Muhammad ﷺ par un ke Rubb ki taraf se koi nishani kyun nahin utari gayi, jaise Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur Isa (alaihis salaam) par utari gayi? Aey Rasool, aap to sirf daraane wale hain jo logon ko Allah ke azaab se daraate hain. Aap ke paas sirf wahi nishaniyan hain jo Allah ne aap ko di hain. Aur har ummat ka ek nabi hai jo unhein haqq ka raasta dikhata aur us ki hidayat deta hai.
8: Allah jaanta hai jo har maada apne pet mein uthaye hue hai. Woh us ke baare mein har baat jaanta hai. Woh jaanta hai ke pet mein kya kami ya kya izafa hota hai, aur kya sehat ya kya beemari. Aur Us ke paas, paak hai Woh, har cheez ek andaze se muqarrar hai, jis mein na kami hogi aur na izafa.
9: Yeh is liye ke Woh, paak hai Woh, har us cheez ko jaanta hai jise Us ki makhlooq nahin dekh sakti aur har us cheez ko bhi jise woh dekh sakti hai. Woh apni sifaat, apne naamon aur apne kaamon mein Bada hai. Aur apni zaat aur apni sifaat mein apni har makhlooq se Buland hai.
10: Woh jaanta hai jo chhipa hai aur jo us se bhi zyada chhipa hai. Aey logo, chahe tum apni baatein chhupao ya khule-aam kaho, Us ke ilm mein dono barabar hain. Aur jo shaks raat ke andhere mein logon ki nigahon se chhipta hai aur jo din ki roshni mein khule-aam kaam karta hai, dono Us ke nazdeek barabar maaloom hain.
11: Us ke paas, paak hai Woh, aise farishte hain jo har shaks par baari baari aate hain. Un mein se kuch raat ko aate hain aur kuch din ko. Woh Allah ke hukm se us ki hifazat karte hain aur us ki baatein aur us ke aamaal likhte hain. Allah kisi qaum ka achha haal us waqt tak bura nahin karta jab tak woh khud apne andar ka shukr ka haal na badal lein. Aur jab Allah, paak hai Woh, kisi qaum ki halakat chahta hai, to koi us ki marzi ko rok nahin sakta. Aur aey logo, Us ke siwa tumhara koi nahin jo tumhare kaam sambhaale aur jis ki taraf tum ruk kar us museebat ko hata sako jo tum par aaye.
12: Aey logo, Wohi hai jo tumhein bijli dikhata hai, jis se tumhare dil mein bijli girne ka dar bhi aata hai aur baarish ki umeed bhi. Aur Wohi hai jo baarish ke paani se bhaare hue baadal uthata hai.
13: Aur gadgadahat Us ki paaki aur Us ki taarif bayan karti hai, paak hai Woh. Aur farishte apne Rubb ki paaki bayan karte hain, Us ki haibat mein aur Us ki izzat aur Us ke adab ki wajah se. Aur Woh bijliyan bhejta hai jo Us ki makhlooq mein se jise Woh chahe maar kar mita dein. Phir bhi kafir Allah ke yakta hone ke baare mein jhagadte hain. Aur Allah qudrat aur taaqat mein Ghalib hai aur un logon ko saza dene mein sakht hai jo Us ke khilaaf jate hain.
14: Tauheed ki pukar sirf Allah hi ke liye hai aur is mein koi Us ka sharik nahin. Aur jin buton ko mushrik Us ke siwa pukarte hain, woh pukarne walon ki kisi baat ka jawab nahin dete. Un ka unhein pukarna aise hai jaise koi pyaasa paani ki taraf apna haath barhaye ke woh us ke munh tak aa jaye aur woh pi le. Magar paani us ke munh tak nahin aayega. Kafiron ka apne buton ko pukarna sirf be-kaar hai aur haqq se bahut door, kyunke un buton mein na un ke liye koi faida laane ki taaqat hai aur na un se koi nuqsan hatane ki.
15: Aur jo kuch aasmaano aur zameen mein hai woh sab sirf Allah hi ko sajda karta hai. Momin aur kafir is mein barabar hain, siwaye is ke ke momin khushi se Us ke saamne jhukta aur sajda karta hai, jab ke kafir na-khushi se jhukta hai, halanke us ki fitrat yeh chahti hai ke woh khushi se jhuke. Aur har us makhlooq ka saya jis ka saya hota hai, din ke shuru aur din ke aakhir mein Usi ke saamne jhukta hai.
16: Aey Rasool, un kafiron se poochiye jo Allah ke saath doosron ki ibadat karte hain: aasmaano aur zameen ka Khaaliq aur un ka chalane wala kaun hai? Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: Allah hi un ka Khaaliq aur un ka chalane wala hai, aur tum khud yeh maante ho. Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: kya tum ne Allah ke siwa aise kaar-saaz bana liye jo khud be-bas hain? Woh na apne liye koi faida laa sakte hain aur na apne se koi nuqsan hata sakte hain. Phir woh doosron ke liye yeh kaise kar sakenge? Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: kya woh kafir, jis mein koi soojh nahin, us momin ke barabar hai jo dekhta hai aur hidayat par hai? Aur kya kufr, jo andheron ki tahein hai, iman ke barabar hai, jo noor hai? Kya unhon ne Allah ke liye aise sharik thehra liye, paak hai Woh, jinhon ne Allah ki takhleeq jaisi koi cheez banayi ho, is tarah ke un ki banayi hui cheez Us ki banayi hui cheez se alag na kar ki ja sake? Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: Allah hi har cheez ka Khaaliq hai. Takhleeq mein Us ka koi sharik nahin. Wohi yakta maabood hai jo akele ibadat ka haqdaar hai, aur Wohi sab par ghalib hai.
17: Allah baatil ke mit jaane aur haqq ke baaqi rehne ki misaal us baarish ke paani se deta hai jo aasman se utarta hai aur jis se nalein beh padti hain, har ek apni kushaadgi ke mutabiq, chhoti ho ya bari. Aur behta hua paani apni satah par jhaag aur kooda le aata hai jo paani ke oopar uth aata hai. Phir Woh baatil aur haqq ki ek aur misaal un dhaaton se deta hai jinhein log pighlane ke liye bhatti mein daalte hain taake logon ke liye zeewar banayein. Baatil us jhaag aur us koode jaisa hai jo paani ke oopar tairta hai, aur us mail jaisa hai jo dhaat pighlane se nikalta hai. Aur haqq us saaf paani jaisa hai jo piya ja sakta hai aur jis se phal, ghaas aur sabze ugte hain; aur us dhaat jaisa hai jo pighlane ke baad bachti hai aur logon ke kaam aati hai. Aur jis tarah Allah ne yeh do misaalein di hain, usi tarah Woh logon ke liye bahut si misaalein deta hai taake haqq baatil se alag ho jaye.
18: Jin mominon ne apne Rubb ki pukar par labbaik kaha jab Us ne unhein apne yakta hone aur apni itaat ki taraf bulaya, un ke liye sab se behtareen ajr hai, yani Jannat. Magar jin kafiron ne Us ke yakta hone aur Us ki itaat ki pukar par labbaik na kaha, agar un ke paas zameen ki har tarah ki daulat ho aur us se dugni bhi, to woh azaab se bachne ke liye yeh sab fidya mein de dein. Jin logon ne Us ki pukar ka jawab na diya, un se un ke tamam bure aamaal ka hisaab liya jayega, aur jis ghar mein woh rahenge woh Jahannam hoga: aur thehrne aur basne ke liye Aag kitni buri jagah hai!
19: Aey Rasool, jo shaks jaanta hai ke jo kuch Allah ne aap par utara woh be-shak aap ke Rubb ki taraf se haqq hai, aur jo Allah par iman rakhta hai aur Us ki pukar par labbaik kehta hai, woh us shaks ke barabar nahin ho sakta jo andha hai, Allah ka inkaar karta hai aur Us ki pukar par labbaik nahin kehta. Aur is se sirf wahi log dhyaan dete aur sabaq lete hain jin ki samajh durust hai.
20: Jo log Allah ki pukar par labbaik kehte hain, wahi hain jo Allah se kiye hue ahd poore karte hain aur woh ahd bhi jo unhon ne Us ke bandon se kiye, aur jo Allah se ya doosron se kiye hue ahd nahin todte.
21: Aur woh wahi log hain jo har us cheez ko jodte hain jis ke jodne ka Allah ne hukm diya, jaise rishtedaron ke taalluqat aur Allah ke liye apne deeni bhaiyon se taalluq; aur jin ke dilon mein apne Rubb ki aisi haibat hai jo unhein Us ke hukm par chalne aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachne par le jati hai; aur jo darte hain ke Allah un se har us gunah ka hisaab lega jo woh karte hain, kyunke jis shaks ke hisaab ki poori chhan-been ho jaye woh barbaad ho jayega.
22: Aur woh wahi log hain jo Allah ki itaat par aur us aasani aur us tangi par jame rahe jo Allah ne un ke liye muqarrar ki, aur Allah ki razamandi chahte hue Us ke khilaaf jaane se bachne par bhi jame rahe. Unhon ne namaz poore tareeqe se qayam ki, aur us maal mein se apne faraiz ada kiye jo Hum ne unhein diya, aur us maal mein se khushi se diya: chhup kar taake dikhawa na ho, aur khule-aam taake doosre un ki pairvi karein. Aur woh un logon ki burai ko neki se hatate hain jo unhein takleef dete hain. In sifaat wale logon ka Qayamat ke din achha anjaam hoga.
23: Yeh achha anjaam un baagon ko kehte hain jin mein woh hamesha naimat mein rahenge. Aur naimat poori karne ke liye un ke baap, un ki maayein, un ki biwiyan aur un ki aulaad mein se jo neik the, woh bhi un ke saath in baagon mein daakhil honge, taake un se mil kar un ka rehna aur khushgawar ho jaye. Is ke saath farishte Jannat mein un ke gharon ke har darwaze se unhein milne aur mubarak-baad dene aayenge.
24: Farishte jab bhi unhein milne aayenge to unhein salaam karenge aur kahenge: tum par salaam ho, yani tum museebaton se mehfooz ho, us sabr ki wajah se jo tum ne Allah ki itaat par aur mushkil waqton mein kiya aur Us ke khilaaf na jaane par jame rahe. Tumhara anjaam kitna achha aakhiri ghar hai!
25: Aur jo log Allah se kiya hua ahd pakka ho jaane ke baad tod dete hain, aur un taalluqat ko kaat dete hain jin ke jodne ka Allah ne hukm diya, wahi bad-naseeb aur zillat wale log hain jo Allah ki rehmat se door kar diye jayenge, aur un ke liye Aag mein ek bura ghar hai.
26: Allah jis ke liye chahta hai rozi kushaada kar deta hai aur apne bandon mein se jis ke liye chahta hai tang kar deta hai. Aur bahut si rozi milna khush-naseeb hone ya Allah ki mohabbat paa lene ki nishani nahin. Isi tarah rozi ka tang hona bad-naseeb hone ki nishani nahin. Aur kafir duniya ki zindagi par khush ho gaye aur us ki taraf jhuk gaye aur us mein aaram se baith gaye. Halanke duniya ki zindagi, Aakhirat ke muqable mein, sirf ek thoda sa maza hai jo jald guzar jayega.
27: Aur jin logon ne Allah aur Us ki aayaton ka inkaar kiya woh kehte hain: kaash Muhammad ﷺ par un ke Rubb ki taraf se koi zaahiri nishani utari jati jo un ki sachhaai saabit karti, phir hum iman le aate. Aey Rasool, aisa kehne walon se keh dijiye: Allah apne insaaf se jise chahe gumraahi mein chhod deta hai, aur apne fazl se un logon ko apni taraf hidayat deta hai jo tauba karke Us ki taraf rujoo karte hain. Hidayat un ke haath mein nahin ke woh use nishaniyan utarne se jod dein.
28: Jin logon ko Allah hidayat deta hai, woh wahi hain jo iman rakhte hain aur jin ke dil Allah ki yaad se, Us ki paaki aur Us ki taarif se, aur Us ki kitab padhne aur sunne se sukoon paate hain. Be-shak Allah ki yaad hi se dil sukoon paate hain.
29: Jo log Allah par iman rakhte hain aur aise neik kaam karte hain jo unhein Allah ke qareeb karte hain, un ke liye Aakhirat mein khushgawar zindagi hai aur Jannat mein achha anjaam.
30: Aur aey Rasool, jis tarah Hum ne pehle rasoolon ko un ki qaumon ki taraf bheja, usi tarah Hum ne aap ko aap ki qaum ki taraf bheja taake aap unhein woh Quran padh kar sunayein jo Hum ne aap par utara, kyunke woh aap ki sachhaai ke liye kaafi daleel hai. Magar aap ki qaum ka haal yeh hai ke woh is mojize ko rad karti hai, kyunke woh Rehman ka inkaar karti hai aur Us ke saath doosron ko sharik thehrati hai. Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: Rehman, jis ke saath tum doosron ko sharik thehrate ho, Wohi mera Rubb hai; Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laayak nahin; apne tamam kaamon mein main Usi par bharosa karta hoon, aur Usi ki taraf tauba karke rujoo karta hoon.
31: Aur agar utari hui kitabon mein se kisi mein yeh khoobi hoti ke us se pahaad apni jaghon se chal padte, ya zameen phat kar nahron aur chashmon mein badal jati, ya woh murdon ko padh kar sunayi jati aur woh zinda ho jate, to woh yahi Quran hota jo aap par utara gaya, aey Rasool, kyunke us ki dalilein khuli hain aur us ka asar gehra hai: kaash un ke dil dhyaan dete, magar woh use rad karte hain. Balke nishaniyan utarne ka maamla aur baaqi tamam maamlaat sirf Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hain. Kya jo log Allah par iman rakhte hain woh nahin jaante ke agar Allah chahta ke bina koi nishani utare tamam logon ko ek saath hidayat de de, to Woh aisa kar deta? Magar Us ne aisa nahin chaaha. Aur jo log Allah ka inkaar karte hain, un par lagatar koi sakht museebat aati rehti hai jo unhein hila deti hai, ya aisi museebat un ke gharon ke qareeb aa padti hai, yahan tak ke Allah ka woh wada poora ho jaye jo lagatar azaab ka hai. Aur Allah apna wada poora karne mein kabhi kotahi nahin karta jab us ka muqarrar waqt aa jata hai.
32: Aur aey Rasool, aap pehle rasool nahin jinhein un ki qaum ne jhutlaya aur un ka mazaaq udaya. Aap se pehle ki ummaton ne bhi apne rasoolon ka mazaaq udaya aur unhein jhutlaya. Magar Maine un logon ko jinhon ne apne rasoolon ko jhutlaya mohlat di, yahan tak ke unhon ne samajha ke Main unhein halak nahin karoonga. Phir Maine us mohlat ke baad unhein tarah tarah ke azaab se pakad liya. Phir aap ka kya khayal hai ke Maine unhein kaisa azaab diya? Woh waqai ek sakht azaab tha!
33: Kya woh jo har jaan ke aamaal par nigraani rakhta hai aur use us ke aamaal ka badla deta hai, ibadat ka zyada haqdaar hai, ya yeh but jin ka koi haqq nahin ke un ki ibadat ki jaye? Phir bhi kafiron ne na-haqq aur jhoot ke saath unhein Allah ka sharik bana liya. Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: hum ko un sharikon ke naam batao jin ki tum Allah ke saath ibadat karte ho, agar tum apne daawe mein sachche ho. Ya kya tum Allah ko zameen par aise sharikon ki khabar dete ho jinhein Woh jaanta hi nahin? Ya tum Use mehaz lafzon ke dikhawe se khabar dete ho jin ki koi haqeeqat nahin? Balke shaytan ne kafiron ke bure mansoobe unhein khoobsurat kar dikhaye. Chunanche unhon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya aur Us ne unhein neki aur hidayat ke raaste se pher diya.
34: Un ke liye is duniya mein bhi ek azaab hai, yani mominon ke haathon maare jana aur qaid hona, magar Aakhirat ka woh azaab jo un ka muntazir hai is duniya ke azaab se zyada sakht aur zyada mushkil hoga, kyunke woh kabhi khatam na hone wala aur lagatar hai. Aur Qayamat ke din un ka koi nahin hoga jo unhein Allah ke azaab se bachaye.
35: Us Jannat ki sifat, jis ka wada un logon se kiya gaya jo Allah se darte hain, Us ke hukm par chalte hain aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hain, yeh hai ke us ke mahalon ke neeche nahrein behti hain, us ke phal hamesha rehne wale hain aur kabhi khatam nahin hote, duniya ke phalon ke bar-aks, aur us ka saya hamesha rehne wala hai aur kabhi simatta nahin. Yahi un logon ka anjaam hai jo Allah se darte hain, Us ke hukm par chalte hain aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hain. Aur kafiron ka anjaam Aag hai, jis mein woh daakhil honge aur hamesha rahenge.
36: Aey Rasool, woh Yahood jinhein Hum ne Taurat di aur woh Nasara jinhein Hum ne Injeel di, un mein se kuch us par khush hote hain jo aap par utara gaya, kyunke woh us mein se kuch ke mutabiq hai jo un par utara gaya tha. Aur Yahood aur Nasara ke kuch giroh us ka kuch hissa rad karte hain jo aap par utara gaya, kyunke woh un ki khwahishon ke mutabiq nahin, ya woh batata hai ke unhon ne apne deen mein tabdeeli aur tod-marod ki. Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: Allah ne mujhe sirf yeh hukm diya hai ke main sirf Usi ki ibadat karoon aur Us ke saath kisi ko sharik na thehraoon. Main sirf Usi ki taraf bulata hoon, kisi aur ki taraf nahin. Aur sirf Usi ki taraf mera lautna hai. Yahi Taurat aur Injeel ne bhi sikhaya tha.
37: Aur jis tarah Hum ne pichli kitabein un ki qaumon ki zubaan mein utari, usi tarah Hum ne aap par, aey Rasool, Quran ko Arabi zubaan mein ek faisla-kun kalaam bana kar utara jo haqq batata hai. Aur aey Rasool, agar aap ahl-e-kitab ki khwahishon ke peeche chalein, un ki is darkhwast mein ke aap us cheez ko hata dein jo un ki khwahishon ke mutabiq nahin, is ilm ke baad jo Allah ne aap ko sikhaya, to aap ka koi nahin hoga jo aap ke kaam sambhaale aur aap ke dushmanon ke khilaaf aap ki madad kare, aur na koi hoga jo aap ko Allah ke azaab se bachaye.
38: Aey Rasool, Hum ne aap se pehle aise rasool bheje jo insaan the, lihaza aap rasoolon mein koi nayi baat nahin. Aur Hum ne unhein doosre insaano ki tarah biwiyan aur aulaad di. Hum ne unhein farishte nahin banaya jo nikah nahin karte aur jin ki aulaad nahin hoti. Aap bhi un hi rasoolon mein se hain jo nikah karte hain aur jin ki aulaad hoti hai. Phir yeh mushrik is par kyun hairan hote hain? Aur koi rasool koi mojiza nahin laa sakta siwaye is ke ke Allah use ijazat de. Aur Allah ke muqarrar kiye hue har maamle ke liye ek kitab hai jis mein us ka zikr hai, aur ek waqt hai jo na pehle aayega aur na der se.
39: Allah jo bhi bhalai, burai, khush-haali ya bad-haali mitana chahta hai mita deta hai, aur jo chahta hai pakka kar deta hai. Aur Usi ke paas Lauh-e-Mehfooz hai, jo in sab ki asal hai, aur jo kuch mitaya ya pakka kiya jata hai woh usi ke mutabiq hota hai.
40: Aey Nabi, agar Main aap ko aap ki maut se pehle us azaab ka kuch hissa dikha doon jis ka Hum un se wada karte hain, to yeh Mera faisla hai. Aur agar Main aap ko woh dikhane se pehle maut de doon, to aap ki zimmedaari sirf yeh hai ke woh pahuncha dein jis ke pahunchane ka Hum ne aap ko hukm diya. Unhein badla dena ya un ka hisaab lena aap ki zimmedaari nahin: woh Mera kaam hai.
41: Kya in kafiron ne nahin dekha ke Hum kafiron ki zameen ki taraf aate hain aur use us ke kinaron se ghatate jate hain: Islam ke phailne se aur musalmanon ke use fatah karne se? Aur Allah apne bandon ke darmiyan jo chahta hai faisla aur hukm karta hai. Koi Us ke faisle ko palat, badal ya tabdeel nahin kar sakta. Woh, paak hai Woh, jald hisaab lene wala hai aur pehle aur baad ke tamam logon ka hisaab ek hi din mein le lega.
42: Aur pichli ummaton ne bhi apne nabiyon ke khilaaf chaalein aur saazishein kein aur un ki laayi hui baat ko jhutlaya. Phir woh apni in chaalon se kya kar sake? Kuch bhi nahin! Yeh is liye ke asar wali tadbeer sirf Allah hi ki hai, kisi aur ki nahin. Wohi, paak hai Woh, jaanta hai ke un ki jaanein kya kamaati hain, aur Woh unhein us ka badla dega. Phir unhein maaloom ho jayega ke Allah par iman na laa kar woh kitne galat the, aur momin kitne theek the, kyunke woh Jannat aur sab se achha anjaam paa lenge.
43: Aur jin logon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya woh kehte hain: aey Muhammad ﷺ, aap ko Allah ne nahin bheja. Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: Allah mere aur tumhare darmiyan gawah ke taur par kaafi hai ke mujhe mere Rubb ne tumhari taraf bheja hai, aur woh log bhi gawah hain jinhein un aasmani kitabon ka ilm hai jin mein meri sifat maujood hai. Aur jis ki sachhaai par Allah gawah ho, use jhutlane walon ka jhutlana koi nuqsan nahin pahunchata.
